name: D-Robotics
summary:
D-Robotics provides computing hardware and software foundations for robot developers. Originating from Horizon Robotics, it supplies the Sunrise intelligent-computing chips and RDK development kits, together with a software platform and developer resources. Its role is to help teams build and deploy intelligent robots rather than focus on a single complete humanoid product.

The platforms support applications including humanoids, wheeled-legged robots, quadrupeds, service and companion robots, logistics AMRs, cleaning robots and lawn mowers. The company serves research institutions, commercial developers and individual makers, providing infrastructure for perception, AI computation and integration into physical robot systems.
categories: Robot Control Boards and Computing Components
